name: Rise Print Lab

about:
Rise Print Lab operates as a custom screen printing shop in Bend, Oregon. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders.

The shop specializes in custom screen printing on a variety of apparel, offering access to t-shirts, long sleeves, hoodies, tanks, polos, and other garment styles. Customers can submit existing artwork for printing or request assistance from a local designer connected through the shop. No details on facility size, employee count, or production volumes are provided.

Rise Print Lab serves customers seeking custom printed apparel, though specific industries or customer types are not listed on its website. The service appears geared toward businesses, organizations, and individuals needing decorated garments for promotional, retail, or personal use.

The company emphasizes its years of experience combined with first-class equipment as the foundation for creating beautiful and premium custom apparel. This pairing of experience and equipment is presented as its core differentiator.
